notes.title: Version 1.5.0 Sports Update is here! And future.
notes.content:
Hello! Here is sports update patch note.


[h1]Bigger changes:[/h1]
- Now you can create your very own Formula team. Formula team will need money for a car developing and drivers. If your season is successful you will get prize money. But that's not only thing that you will get. Your company brand value will skyrocket and same happens to your products. So you will get huge marketing boost from here.

- Football team. Football team will need money for players and facilities. Here is same thing. If your season is successful you will get huge prize money and your marketing will get huge boost.

- I made huge update for product points system. Main priority was that in future it will not be possible to sell milk for 1000€ price.

[h1]New things.[/h1]
- Now you can't choose electricity prize yourself. Electricity price will go now up and down with markets and your electricity will always sell in market price.

- Power stations will now automatically hire workers that they need to work. So you don't need to worry about that.

- Plan is to remove more numbers from game and change them to text. The first thing changed is in the shops, you will now get text feedback on whether your product price is good or bad.

- We wanted to help players in Raw Materials section too. Now you don't need to go in there and add price. Price will be market value always, but you can choose present value of market value. I mean if you want to sell oil for 90% of the market value and market value is 10€ you will sell oil for 9€.

- Own products page you see now how good price is, not product points.

- Now when you go to "Change salary" page you see what workers wish for salary.

- Huge optimization. I personally get 30% better results now

- Now you can add five floors to apartments with one click.

- You can now add 31 floors in apartments.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- AI started to manufacture it's own products in factory which it was renting.

- If you had CEO and you give the CEO rights to price controls and add profit goal to 30%, CEO increased prices by 3000%.

- More than 5 reactors can now be built.

- Coal power plant can’t have more than 5 engines.

- AI chose product prices little bit wrong. I made few changes to this.

- If you set music volume to zero from settings music volume was really 1%.

- AI build iron mines on coal slots.

- AI hire more and more workers to raw material building if production was too small. Real problem was logistic.

- If you fire CEO for asking more salary he’d leave your company but his ghost was still in company.



[h1]Community help and future[/h1]
Now i hope you will tell how your Sports careers start so i can fix and optimize if needed.


The next updates will focus more on balancing the new features released with this update, and general optimization and improvements to existing systems. The users have asked for more focus on the basics, so I’ll focus on those mainly for a while now. It’s unlikely I’ll be working on any new features in the near future so don’t expect them, instead I’ll be fully focusing on working on improving the systems and features already in place.



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29988495/581baef2a7e7cc2acc0c4bc408a1fba6a48a50dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Sports update release plans
notes.content:
Hello!

I told you about BusinessMan new Sports update over mounth ago and now i can tell you that update is in Closed Alpha testing. If all go fine update will be out in next week.

Update have big changelog and i will release full changelog when update is out, but here is main things about this udpate.

[h1]Formula team[/h1]
Now you can create your very own Formula team. Formula team will need money for a car developping and drivers. If your season is succesfull you will get prize moneys. But that's not only thing what you will get. Your company brand value will get huge kick to sky and same happen your all products. So you will get huge marketing help from here.

Formula team is very expensive and it's good to make at least 1billion free money when you start your own formula team. Because first seasons will be very expensive and you will not get any success in season because your car is not so good.

[h1]Football team[/h1]
Football team. Football team will need money to players and facilities. Here is same thing. If your season is successfully you will get huge prize money and your marketing will get huge boost.

Football team is not so expensive that formula, but my recommendation is that you made 300-500million free money to use your football team. First seasons can be very expensive. But when your facilities level rise you can save money with lower player budget.



[h1]Community help[/h1]
I really hope you will like this update. And if you have ideas what you want to see in BusinessMan in future please go to forum and share your ideas. I have plans still to update BusinessMan whole 2019 year. One plan is still in UI. I want to rework whole UI in future.

notes.title: V.1.3.0. Big graphics update and something else
notes.content:
We’ve finally finished this update!

We already updated the models once, but we decided to update them once more, a notch more. We also updated the product graphics into better ones.
We also launched a new difficulty system, some slight changes to the endless-mode and a global scoreboard.
Now you can play the game on any difficulty you see fit, and once the game is over, your score will be saved into that difficulty rankings scoreboard, which will be a top-10 for each difficulty level. You can also find a honorary mentions board inside the BusinessMan game. 

And of course there have been several bug fixes too, of which I’ve listed some of the bigger ones below, under the updates.

[h1]New stuff:[/h1]
- Global honorary board
- When you die, you’ll have the option to keep playing in endless mode, so you don’t have to decide it beforehand in character creation.
- Character creation window has been updated
- A new save system for highscores
- New product graphics
- New models; construction, it-office, construction office, store.
- Visual updates to oil pumps
- New ground textures
- Wiki-pages can now be accessed via the pause menu
- We’ll keep updating the wiki as new content gets added.

[h1]Bug fixes: [/h1]
- When asking for investment, the conversation window sometimes opened -under the profile window
- Selling and producing operating systems caused several bugs
- Several smaller bugfixes
- Code optimization

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29988495/3f53aad307bb954649f61e72ea69aa63f77f7855.png[/img]

notes.title: New big update V.1.2.0! Germany language and other thinks!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
It's been a long time since last update. The reason was that we have been developing an upgrade with our Beta team. 
We fixed lots of bugs that are listed below. We made a German translation into the game, and thanks to [R.I.P] Rest In Pieces [GER] for that.

I also want to thank Nyphty for the Youtube video he made.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vEdmAm1DC8s&feature=youtu.be

We also changed some windows. New windows for your own products, Trade Management and Factory Management.

We will continue to actively develop according to feedback so keep up your activity! Your feedback is important as we don’t notice everything and we will listen to feedback and work on the game based on feedback.

New things
- German language.
- New resolution of 1920 x 1080 has been added
- The global economic situation is now affecting housing prices and housing sales. For example, in a bad economy, selling houses is almost impossible
- E-mails now show the date they were sent to the player
- A transparent sign will be shown in the middle of the screen whenever time is stopped, as a heads up for the player
- Sounds added to some buttons when pressed
- Factory management window renewed
- Shop management window renewed
- Now when you are trying to get a loan from a bank, banks calculate the loan a little differently
- AI got some improvements.

Bugs:
- If you changed the time from the top corner, there was a small delay.
- Translation errors
- All the products sold in a player's store would randomly get taken off from sale
- If played with a low resolution game, the factory window could not be closed
- Repairing the building block was a visible development center
- Occasional game crashes and freezing if one company succeeded one month before or on the last day
- The language selection settings page was broken
- Construction areas go randomly on top of each other
- With low resolutions, it was not possible to switch to factory production
- If you went to the main menu and from there back to the game there were occasional crashes. These should no longer come but report if it comes because this fault has been spellbound long and was always absent from time to time.
- Some windows were completely black if the windows were for some reason overlapping

notes.title: Big update! V.1.1.0 - Old saves not working anymore.

Today we completed a bit bigger upgrade package that will change the look.
The update included a small disadvantage, which means that old save games will not work. I’m sorry. I try all but no. Reason is that i change the whole city generating system. The new system makes the map much larger (over 150 new sites).
The upgrade will update the buildings completely to the new collections, thanks to the Almiradjo! 
We also updated the UI slightly.
We also released a new trailer. And also i have planned a completely new feature of which more later when it is due, but i have read your feedbacks and i get many ideas.

- A new model. Factory, Shop, Office, Development Center, Oil Pump and Farm.

- Little live in the city when the cars are driving there.
- The whole city is generated by being transformed into a new system.

[h1]fixes:[/h1]
- Several corrections related to buttons that did not show the full text and texture bugs.
- Occasionally when started the game started the game so that the day time was 2x the maximum faster.
- The newspaper was not translated in english.
- There were errors in the resolution on the stock page
- Now all buildings watching road and not are same direction

- Port and the creation of a new prototype buttons on the bottom corner had the same graphics.
- If you were looking for a CEO in your company, it always took almost a year for someone to take the job. Here was a small bug that was repaired.

notes.title: Hello! New update is here again! V.1.0.2 - Tutorial and Wiki
notes.content:
Hello you people! Here is another update for you guys!

I now made a whole new wiki system. In addition, the tutorial is now on by default. But what else did this update bring with it? Report bugs to me so i can fix those. And i am open for ideas too!

[h1]New things:[/h1]
- WIKI. Now in the upper right corner of several windows you find button where is mark ?. If you press that it open wiki page. Wiki will be updated further on how to see that it is necessary.
[h1]fixes:[/h1]
- When creating a figure, the amount of money exceeded its limits.
- The size of the world was only displayed in Finnish
- If you tried to start the game so that the character name was less than 3 characters, nothing was reported to the player. But the player might wonder why the start button did not work.
- The tutorial was set to off default for all players.
- In Finnish only the written text was also found in the share of the window.
- UI bugs corrected.

notes.title: Hotfix update V.1.0.1 and how we go on now?
notes.content:
Everything does not always go as you wanted and in SugGames's first game release everything that can go wrong seems to be going wrong.

I decided to publish hotfix update now. I got feedback and wanted make this update as soon as possible. Update fixes some of the major mistakes in the game. All corrected and altered things are multiplied at the end of the news.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
This was just a hotfix update. The designs have a bigger upgrade that will hopefully be announced first week. The upgrade is intended to bring you a higher quality tutorial and a separate wiki page to learn more about the game's various issues.

Keep getting connected and reporting bugs!

[h1]Fixed bugs:[/h1]
- When you hit the retirement button, you came up with a window where your character was dead
- If you were looking at a stock exchange for some company data from different tabs and you chose a new business, the tab was not reset
- If the game played with resolution less than 1200, it was not able to buy shares.
- If the president threatened to kick and asked for more time, that button did not always have any effect.
- In some cases when the company became a new CEO, the value indicating how long the CEO has been employed in that company was zeroed until the month changed.
- We fixed the translation mistakes

[h1]Things we changed[/h1]
- We changed the company's creation GUI window graphics
- We changed the character settings of the window graphics.
- Now when you start the game you will be asked the first language you want to play


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29988495/1b66ded46ad112236377f3e9a6367e166fe2a506.png[/img]
